name: egm
description: Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes.

interface.longDescription: Develop ideas and review plans in ChatGPT on web and desktop. EGM in Chat works from your conversation and supplied documents with same-context critique. Full EGM provides independent reviewers when the chat exposes verified fresh-context subagents and artifact access. Repository workflows additionally require repository access and command execution. Each workflow checks available tools before starting. Not an officially supported Google product.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this idea into a clear plan.
Review this proposal for gaps and unclear assumptions.
Review this software design before we build it.
